title: Unblock VOX scene approval and asset previews
description: Allow the simplified Scene Review checkpoint to continue after approved scene assets are persisted, even while voice generation is pending, and allow local lsf-media asset previews through the renderer CSP.
businessContext: The resumed VOX smoke reached Scene Review with every scene asset approved and assigned, but the Approve Scene control was disabled because the asset-review artifact was already approved. The real preview URLs were also blocked by the renderer CSP.
acceptanceCriteria: Approve Scene is enabled when the selected scene has approved, assigned assets, regardless of pending voice segments or an already approved asset-review artifact.
Approving the persisted scene review continues the existing production orchestrator without rerunning scene visuals.
Renderer asset previews using lsf-media:// are not rejected by the document CSP.
Focused syntax/type checks and diff checks pass; no final voice, preview, or export evidence is fabricated.
humanEscalationConditions: The existing orchestrator requires a backend contract change outside the renderer-scoped paths.
